task.description: Gate ELIXIR-DEV's step-03 implementation on feature/WF03-ISS0733-20260921 (commit 4d014e6d) against INV-1..INV-8. Run `git diff main...feature/WF03-ISS0733-20260921 -- lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex lib/letflow/event_store.ex lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex` directly and verdict each invariant against the real diff, not against any prior agent's summary. Two specific things to scrutinize per the design doc's own flagged open question (OQ-3): (1) the new GET /promotions/platform-events route (R11) discloses cross-tenant data (a DEFINITION_PROMOTED event names BOTH source_tenant_id and target_tenant_id) -- confirm the route's authz gate is genuinely PLATFORM_ADMIN-only (not merely target-tenant-scoped) and that no ordinary tenant-scoped caller can reach it. (2) the new Audit.insert_entry call inside promote_definition/3's transaction (write_target_definition/5) -- confirm it writes to the correct tenant-scoped prefix (target_prefix, matching every other write in that transaction) and does not leak source-tenant identifiers into a row a target-tenant caller could read via the normal tenant-scoped GET /api/v1/audit (INV-1's tenant isolation).
acceptance_criteria: Verdict recorded per invariant INV-1..INV-8, APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE stated for each, per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md's worked example shape
The new route's authz gate independently confirmed PLATFORM_ADMIN-only by reading the actual plug/guard code, not the design doc's claim alone
